entities.summary: Paddy Moloney was an Irish musician, composer, and record producer. He co-founded and led the Irish musical group the Chieftains, playing on all of their 44 albums. He was particularly associated with the revival of the uilleann pipes. Paddy Moloney was a composers & musicians from Dublin (1938-08-01, Dublin–2021-10-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
